source.check: the twenty-three divisions and names read from the Ballymena Observer's report of the nominations (5 May 1933, p. 10), headed 'Ballymena Rural Council: no contest'

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, one for each of the twenty-three electoral divisions. Nominations were received on Wednesday 3 May 1933 and there was no contest in any division, so all the nominees were returned unopposed. Polling in County Antrim took place on 1 June 1933. Old member. Returned unopposed.
